AMD FSR SDK v2.4.0, commit 7539ae8b6568ad29ed78a753404351daf3b5cca7.
The signed Vulkan loader and upscaler DLLs are unmodified.
The portable INT8 shader programs and model weights were captured from the
FSR SDK 2.4.0 DX12 upscaler (SHA256 aad4fccccb29084a655f9a4f9f613bd22c8c03fb4a0f8840148cc6543b4ccace),
translated with dxil-spirv and assigned Vulkan descriptor bindings.
The postpass store pattern is rewritten; the portable prepass expands the
VALVE mixed float dot product into FP32 operations and is not bit-exact
against AMD hardware. These are modified, unofficial assets.
Source: https://github.com/Mob1K7105/beamng-fsr4-linux
Commit: fc00541e49c390cf3b57903ab00968e89794d189
The MIT exception for the upscaler DLL is included in LICENSE.txt.
Native wrapper and portable replay: GPL-2.0-or-later, repository LICENSE.

vcruntime140_1.dll, distributed app-locally from the Visual Studio 2022
Build Tools VC/Redist/MSVC/14.44.35112/x64/Microsoft.VC143.CRT directory.
